assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished background illustration asset for a premium royal-themed mobile match-3 puzzle game, portrait 1024x1536. Vibrant polished rounded 3D cartoon art like a lavish storybook castle courtyard. Bright turquoise blue sky in upper quarter, cream-stone castle walls and round blue-roof turrets with warm golden trims along left and right edges, small flowing scarlet banners. Broad inviting blue royal carpet with gold edge on cool blue-gray stone paving in bottom half. Lush trimmed green shrubs and a few flower pots at outer edges. View slightly elevated facing into a courtyard with a distant arched golden gate. Center 70% width and middle 65% height should be calm, simple, low-detail blue-gray paving and sky so a game board can sit on top clearly. Strong readable silhouettes, soft bevels, beautiful ambient occlusion, warm sun at upper left, saturated royal blue and turquoise, golden highlights and muted lavender shadows. No characters, no gems, no puzzle board, no panels, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Fully finished production game environment background, not a UI mockup.
